binary_provenance.scope: Official precompiled image member; runtime dependencies and functional qualification are separate.

limitations: This is a fixed classic-memory RV64 hello syscall-emulation profile; other ISAs, CPU models, full-system mode and Ruby/MESI coherence are not functionally qualified.
Atomic memory mode and no explicit cache hierarchy; this fixture does not model timing-mode contention or qualify hardware performance.
Simulator ticks/statistics are model outputs, not real CPU measurements; host wall-clock is never used as an optimization score.

Official image prebuilt; exact binary identity is image/layer/member/derived SHA256. The observed embedded version is 24.0.0.0 but matching source-tag commit is only a release reference, not proof of binary reproducibility.

The official --build-info/banner incorrectly reads missing m5.defines.gem5Version; -q suppresses that display only. Actual version comes from _m5.core.gem5Version during successful simulation. The failed probes are retained.
Private dependencies are bundled; compatible platform libraries listed in host_library_requirements remain required and are resolved by the unchanged CPG ELF checker.
